title: feat(scripts): --fix derives skill body versions; release guard and token ratchet follow
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbPjpDtuAfMiZPGY3g5SZw34)_

Fixes #31115 (item 3, the last; items 1 and 2 landed in #31432).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `check:skill-compatibility` 现在也检查技能正文里写死的版本号（如 `bootstrap.md` 起步 package.json 里的 5 个 `"@objectstack/…": "18.3.0"`），发版时由 `--fix` 自动改写；新导出 `bodyPinnedPaths()` 列出会被改写的文件，release.yml 的发版后守卫据此放行；token 棘轮不再计价这些由脚本写入的版本值。
- **为什么改：** 正文版本号以前靠手改，已经落后过一次；按裁决 B（「31115 … 同意」）把它变成派生值，并堵住 `18.9`→`18.10` 这类变宽导致 Version Packages PR 被棘轮打红的坑（`bootstrap.md` 余量只有 1）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改两个检查脚本和 release.yml 的一个守卫步骤，不动运行时代码和技能文本；在本地模拟了一次升到 `18.10.0-next.12` 的发版：`--fix` 改写 12 个文件，守卫零意外路径，棘轮保持绿。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `.github/workflows/release.yml`（新增 `BODY_LIST`，第六个过滤器，空列表合法）；`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`（`bodyPinValues` 与 `BODY_PIN_REPIN`，`bootstrap.md` 行 1351→1343）；`scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs`（`bodyPinnedPaths`、`applyFix`）。
- **两分钟验证：** 运行 `pnpm check:skill-compatibility` 和 `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test`，应分别看到「6 body version(s) in 71 skill markdown file(s)」和「104 cases pass」。
- **需要你做的：** 这是受管面 PR（`.github/workflows/release.yml`），需要一位受管审批人批准（APPROVED review）。

## What changes

- **`scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs`.**
  - The check now judges every body version under `skills/**`. A version must equal its workspace package's version, or sit in a sentence that reads as history (`since`, `removed in`, `until`, …). An install pin is always judged.
  - `--fix` rewrites body versions in the same pass as the frontmatter. `applyFix` writes each file once, and a range (`^`/`~`) is kept.
  - New export `bodyPinnedPaths()`: the files whose body the writer owns. The writer is asked with a probe value, so a file stays listed after the pass made it current. A history-only file is never listed. A moved skills directory throws; a catalog with no pins answers `[]`.
  - The reader, the history rule and `deriveBodyVersions` come from the first item 3 commit, now called.
- **`.github/workflows/release.yml`, "Validate the post-version tree".**
  - `BODY_LIST` is resolved from `bodyPinnedPaths()` and applied as a sixth whole-line `grep -vxF -f` filter.
  - Unlike the four lists above it, an empty list is legitimate and admits nothing; a failed resolve still fails the step.
  - The content half already runs `check:skill-compatibility`, which now judges the bodies.
- **`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the second exclusion.**
  - Body pin VALUES the writer rewrites are not priced. `bodyPinValues()` reads them off `deriveBodyVersions` with a probe, so there is no second parser.
  - The package name, quotes, range, and every history version stay priced.
  - `pricedTokens` takes `bodyPinned`, and `run()` reads `bodyPinnedPaths()`.
  - `bootstrap.md`'s row is re-pinned 1351 → 1343, the same 8 its count fell (five `18.3.0` values are 30 bytes, 5398 → 5368), so its headroom stays 1. This is recorded as `BODY_PIN_REPIN`.
  - The header gains the ruling and a hand audit (`grep | sed | tr | wc`) that the self-test reproduces on the live file.

## Why

The maintainer ruled B on the item 3 decision (「31115 … 同意」, 2026-11-09; triage record 6730018726). `--fix` rewrites the install-shape body pins at version time; the written set is declared to the release guard; and the ratchet stops pricing writer-rewritten body pin values, generalising the frontmatter stamp-line rule. Without the third part, a width change at release reds `bootstrap.md` on the Version Packages PR.

## Tests

<details><summary>Self-tests, scans and a simulated release</summary>

- `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`: the self-test passes 22 check cases and 22 `--fix` derivation cases (floor 30 → 44). The new cases: the written set equals `stampedSkillPaths()` then `bodyPinnedPaths()` on an all-stale fixture; a history-only file is neither listed nor written; the guard's `grep -vxF -f` admits a body write only through the body list, and an empty list admits nothing; the export throws on a moved tree and answers `[]` with no pins; on the live tree the writer's list equals the reader's. The scan reads "6 body version(s) in 71 skill markdown file(s)", and `--fix` on main is a no-op.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: 104 cases pass (floor 97 → 104). The new cases: exactly the owned value bytes are unpriced, never a range, a name or a history version; any pin width from `17.7.0` to `18.10.0-next.12` moves no count; one authored byte over a zero-headroom row is red at every width; on the live file the writer's bytes equal the reader's; the header's hand audit reproduces the live count; and the re-pin record. The scan is green, with `bootstrap.md` at 1342 / 1343.
- **Simulated release** (restored afterwards). The five pinned packages were set to `18.10.0-next.12` and `--fix` was run.
  - It rewrote 11 SKILL.md stamps and the five `bootstrap.md` pins (12 files), and the check stayed green.
  - With the body list, the guard filters left 0 unexpected paths. Without it, `bootstrap.md` was unexpected.
  - The ratchet stayed green at 1342 / 1343 (75 unpriced bytes). Priced whole, the file would read 1361 against the old 1351.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Card item 3:** body versions are judged and derived. The `--fix` writes are declared to the release guard, and the ratchet does not price them, as ruled.
- **Files outside the original claim surface, by ruling:** `.github/workflows/release.yml` and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`. #31335 was already on main when this branch was cut, so no merge of main was needed.
- **`skills/**` readings:** no file under `skills/**` changes. `bootstrap.md` stays at 190 → 190 lines, and the bundle (all SKILL.md) at 4592 → 4592 lines.
- **Not judged:** a version that names a package the workspace lacks is listed by `bodyPinnedPaths()` as writable. The check reds it, so no green tree carries one.

## Verification

- Head `1415775e` (merge base `f2abd4767`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 55 derived, 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, and all 55 exit 0 at this head. `--tier`: no path-derived mandate, so this was built on the default tier.
- Left to this PR's check-runs: the artifact-roster and wide-population families, the path-scheduled CI jobs, the type-check lanes and the always-runs tail that dispatch-gates prints outside the derived total. The release lane itself runs only on a Version Packages pass; the simulated release under Tests stands in for it.
- Deviations: none from the ruling. The branch was restarted from main after #31432 merged, and the held item 3 commit was re-applied from its patch, so history was not rewritten.
